description: This file is the entry point for a React application. It imports React and ReactDOM, along with CSS styling and the main App component. It initializes the React app by attaching it to the DOM element with id 'root' and renders the App component within React.StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to render a React component tree into a DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React components into the created root.
